note: Groups OVERLAP: knee/below_knee/foot_ankle are nested subsets of thigh, and most dedicated_head cases are also full_head. All cases are 1.5 mm isotropic. No hands or forearms exist anywhere in the dataset.

full_head.title: Full / near-full cranium
full_head.criterion: skull mask spans >= 100 mm in z

knee.title: Knee inside the volume
knee.criterion: femur present and volume extends > 10 mm below its distal end

below_knee.title: Lower leg (below the knee)
below_knee.criterion: volume extends > 60 mm below the distal femur

foot_ankle.title: Foot / ankle
foot_ankle.criterion: volume extends > 300 mm below the distal femur (all 5 visually confirmed)
